interface.signature: def findSwapValues(A: list[int], B: list[int], N: int, M: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B)
preconditions.description: All elements in A and B must be integers.
The lengths of A and B must match the given sizes N and M.
The sizes N and M must be at least 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if any((sum(A) - a + b) == (sum(B) - b + a) for a in A for b in B) else -1
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if there exists a pair (a, b) where a is in A and b is in B such that swapping them makes the sums of A and B equal; otherwise returns -1.
